raw.details:
Overview

Get ready for 24 hours of building, testing, breaking, and innovating!

Agentic Arena, organised under TECHNEX'26 at St. Vincent Pallotti College of Engineering and Technology (SVPCET), Nagpur, is an Agentic AI Hackathon bringing together student innovators to develop practical, intelligent agent-based solutions to domain-specific challenges.

This competition begins with an online abstract submission round, followed by a 24-hour offline hackathon where shortlisted teams will build, test, and demonstrate their solutions.

For Problem Statements => https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NST3K4gjyPFFMWQxB7F0lo3HWX5-8-zh?usp=sharing

Domains

Participants can choose from the following domains:

  • Biotechnology & Life Sciences
  • SpaceTech & Aerospace
  • AI & Cognitive Systems
  • Robotics & Automation
  • Cybersecurity

Competition Format

Round 1 – Online Registration & Abstract Submission

  • After registering, all teams must join the official WhatsApp group for important announcements, updates, and instructions.
  • Teams must download the official Problem Statement PDF provided by the organisers.
  • Each team must select ONE problem statement of their choice from the official document.
  • Prepare an abstract proposing a solution to the selected problem statement, following the prescribed abstract format.
  • Submit the completed abstract through the Unstop submission portal before the announced deadline.
  • Submitted abstracts will be evaluated by the organising team, and shortlisted teams will qualify for the on-site hackathon.

Suggested Abstract Structure:

  • Team Name and Participant Details
  • Selected Problem Statement (ID and Title)
  • Understanding of the Problem
  • Proposed Solution
  • Agentic AI Approach and Workflow
  • Proposed Technologies and Tools
  • Expected Outcomes and Impact

Join the WhatsApp group => https://chat.whatsapp.com/KBENvs433KbCTgGRSkHjkY

Round 2 – Build & Initial Evaluation (Offline)

Shortlisted teams will participate in the 24-hour on-site hackathon at SVPCET, Nagpur.

  • Develop a functional solution based on your selected problem statement.
  • Demonstrate reasoning, planning, tool integration, workflow execution, and meaningful agentic behaviour.
  • Participate in evaluation checkpoints assessing problem understanding, agent architecture, implementation, and progress.
  • Approximately 30–35 teams are planned to qualify for the next stage.

Round 3 – Break Your Opponent's Agent & Final Pitch

Put your agent to the ultimate test!

  • Test another team's agent in a controlled challenge environment.
  • Identify weaknesses in reasoning, tool usage, reliability, security, and error recovery.
  • Evaluate how effectively agents handle unexpected inputs and challenging scenarios.
  • The top 10 teams will advance to the final pitch.
  • Present your solution, architecture, testing, results, limitations, and live demonstration before the jury.

Prizes & Recognition

  • Total Prize Pool: Rs. 40,000
  • Special Recognition: Best Agent Design
  • Certificates for all participants.

Participation Details

  • Eligibility: Students from all colleges and universities
  • Team Size: 2–4 members
  • Mode: Online abstract submission followed by an offline hackathon
  • Venue: St. Vincent Pallotti College of Engineering and Technology (SVPCET), Nagpur
  • On-site Hackathon Dates: 19–20 December 2026

Tools & Technologies

Participants are free to use:

  • Large Language Models (LLMs) and model APIs
  • AI coding assistants
  • Agent frameworks and libraries
  • Databases and cloud services
  • Open-source tools and pre-built components

All pre-built components must be disclosed and properly attributed. Teams must clearly explain their original contributions and comply with applicable licences and service terms.

Required Submissions

Online Round:

- Abstract in PDF format based on one selected problem statement from the official Problem Statement PDF.

On-site Hackathon:

  • GitHub repository with source code and README
  • Working prototype and demonstrable end-to-end workflow
  • Final presentation (PPT/PDF)
  • Supporting technical documentation

Important Instructions

  • Joining the official WhatsApp group is mandatory.
  • Abstract submissions must be made through the Unstop submission portal.
  • Teams must follow the official abstract format and submission deadline.
  • Plagiarism, unauthorised copying, and misrepresentation of work are prohibited.
  • Shortlisting and evaluation decisions will be made by the organising committee and jury.

The Mission

BUILD. DEPLOY. PROVE. PITCH.

Build an agent. Push its limits. Prove what it can do.
